svg.aria-label: Each word's 1300 maps become tokens, pass a two-layer transformer and a learned-query attention layer, and come out as one 16 by 16 map. The pair is stacked, flattened to 512, projected to 256, passed through a one-token transformer, joined with a step vector and read by an MLP into five logits.
svg.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: The head: pool each word's stack into one map, then read the pair
Sizes from the authors' SD 2.1 config, with SDXL's 1,300 maps per word as our proposal. The aggregator's weights are shared by both words.
Trained weights: 1,964,581 on the SD config, 4,860,965 on the FLUX.1-dev config.
The time input is the step number 0 to 49, snapped up to one of 5, 10, 15, 20, 25 or 49, looked up in a 50-row table.
